list.title: Form builder
list.subtitle: Monitoring and practice forms: positions, their roles and the items in them. Once every rule passes, the form is frozen.
list.emptyBody: Start from a template: the monitoring template already places 12 horizontal anchors in positions 10–21, plus 5 pretest and 13 core slots. The practice template has no anchors.
list.filterEmptyBody: Pick another mode or grade, or clear the filters.

create.title: New form
create.labelErr: Enter a name for the form.
create.templateMon: 30 positions: 12 horizontal anchors (positions 10–21), 5 pretest and 13 core.
create.templatePr: 18 positions: 13 core and 5 pretest. No anchor slots.
create.templateOff: Empty form: you add the positions yourself.

head.subMon: Monitoring form · {n} positions: {a} horizontal anchors, {p} pretest items and {c} core items.
head.subPr: Practice form: {n} positions — {c} core and {p} pretest items. Anchors are excluded.
head.prTitle: Practice form: the anchor slots are gone
head.prBody: Anchors aren’t hidden by this screen — the query that selects candidate items excludes them, so an anchor can’t reach a practice form even by mistake. If one leaked into practice, it would be in the parents’ chats by evening and the monitoring waves would no longer be comparable. Pretest items stay: their answers are tagged “practice” and support only preliminary calibration.

grid.caption: Click a position to see its item
grid.label: Form positions
grid.noVertical: No vertical anchors: grade 4 is the top grade
grid.noPositions: The form has no positions yet. Add the first one below.

plan.addLbl: Add a position at the end
plan.removeBody: Position {n} is removed from the plan. Its item {code} leaves the form.
plan.changeRoleWarn: Changing the role clears the item at this position: an item chosen for one role isn’t automatically right for another.

slot.emptyBody: Choose an item for this role: only the bank’s candidate query offers the list.
slot.noDifficulty: Not calibrated · no expected p given
slot.invalid: This item no longer fits this position (retired, or not approved for this role). Replace it.
slot.frozenNote: The form is frozen. To swap an item, create a new form.

cand.title: Candidates
cand.hint: Only latest frozen versions that fit this role. Items already in the form aren’t shown.
cand.hintPractice: Practice form: anchor items never reach this list at all.
cand.empty: No matching candidates. Pick another cluster or clear the search.

rules.title: Rule checks
rules.filledNone: The form has no positions yet
rules.spread: Anchors span the full difficulty range
rules.spreadFail: Needs at least 3 anchors: easy, medium and hard.
rules.middle: Anchors in the middle, not at the end
rules.middleNone: No anchors placed yet: they belong in positions {lo}–{hi}
rules.middleFail: {list} outside the middle ({lo}–{hi}). Children tire towards the end, so the same item behaves differently there and the waves stop being comparable.
rules.pretestOk: {count} items · unscored · no effect on the child’s result
rules.pretestOkPr: {count} items · answers tagged “practice” for preliminary calibration
rules.pretestScored: {n} pretest items are marked as scored
rules.noAnchorMon: Enforced in the candidate query, not on this screen
rules.noAnchorOk: Not a single anchor among the {n} items
rules.bilingual: Uzbek and Russian versions both present
rules.naAnchors: Not applicable: a practice form has no anchors
rules.naCluster: Not applicable: practice only shows how many were solved

strip.title: Difficulty spread
strip.sub: Anchors should be a miniature copy of the whole test — not only easy or only hard items.
strip.subPr: How the practice form’s core items run from easy to hard.
strip.byP: No calibration yet: items are placed by the author’s expected share solving them.
strip.pretestNote: The {n} pretest items aren’t shown: they aren’t calibrated yet.

freeze.title: Freeze the form
freeze.body: Once frozen, items, positions and roles are locked for good. Any change needs a new form.
freeze.blocked: A rule fails. Fix it before freezing.
freeze.dlgFmt: {name} will be locked: {n} item versions, their positions and roles. This can’t be undone — to change anything later you’ll need a new form.
freeze.dlgMon: Every child taking a wave that uses this form gets exactly this form.
freeze.dlgPr: Teachers will be able to assign exactly this form.
freeze.frozenBody: The form is read-only and kept for the record. To change anything, start a new form from it.

states.errBody: The item bank didn’t respond. Nothing is lost: every change is saved as you make it.
states.listErrBody: The item bank didn’t respond. Try again in a moment.
states.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date. Pick a form from the list.
states.noAccessTitle: You don’t have access to this section
states.noAccessBody: Forms are built by the bank editor only. Ask an administrator if you need access.

errors.frozen: The form is frozen and can’t be changed. The page was refreshed.
errors.duplicate_position: A position appears twice. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.no_such_position: That position isn’t in the plan. The page was refreshed.
errors.anchor_in_practice: A practice form can’t have an anchor position.
errors.not_a_candidate: That item can’t fill this position: it isn’t a candidate for this role.
errors.not_a_practice_candidate: That item can’t go into a practice form (an anchor, or not approved).
errors.NOT_FOUND: Form not found. The page was refreshed.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have permission to do that.
errors.NETWORK: The connection dropped. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
